mapper.select:
WITH class AS (SELECT ta.student_id,
-- 수업명 (한자 / 독서) STUFF( (SELECT ', ' + cc2.class_name FROM erp_time_table_assign ta2 JOIN erp_time_table t2 ON ta2.time_table_key = t2.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc2 ON t2.class_key = cc2.class_key WHERE ta2.student_id = ta.student_id AND t2.yy = #{year} AND t2.mm = #{month} AND cc2.class_type IN ('1', '2') FOR XML PATH ('') ), 1, 2, '' ) AS subject,
-- 한자 선생님 MAX(CASE WHEN cc.class_type = '1' THEN u.user_name END) AS hanTeacher,
-- 독서 선생님 MAX(CASE WHEN cc.class_type = '2' THEN u.user_name END) AS bookTeacher,
-- 한자 선생님 MAX(CASE WHEN cc.class_type = '1' THEN u.user_code END) AS assign_han_teacher,
-- 독서 선생님 MAX(CASE WHEN cc.class_type = '2' THEN u.user_code END) AS assign_book_teacher
FROM erp_time_table_assign ta JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON t.class_key = cc.class_key JOIN erp_user u ON t.user_code = u.user_code
WHERE t.yy = #{year} AND t.mm = #{month} AND cc.class_type IN ('1', '2')
GROUP BY ta.student_id), pay AS (SELECT p.student_id, p.payment_key AS paymentKey,
MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'edu_fee' AND pd.class_type = 1 THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END) AS hanFee, MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'edu_fee' AND pd.class_type = 2 THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bookFee,
MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'book_fee' AND pd.class_type = 1 THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END) AS hanMaterialFee, MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'book_fee' AND pd.class_type = 2 THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END) AS bookMaterialFee,
(MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'edu_fee' AND pd.class_type = 1 THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END) + MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'edu_fee' AND pd.class_type = 2 THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS totalFee,
(MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'book_fee' AND pd.class_type = 1 THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END) + MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'book_fee' AND pd.class_type = 2 THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END)) AS totalMaterialFee,
-- 교육비 미납금액 CASE WHEN ( (MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' AND pd.class_type = '1' THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END) + MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' AND pd.class_type = '2' THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END)) - ( ISNULL(pm.total_amount, 0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(pb2.amount) FROM erp_payment_bill pb2 WHERE pb2.payment_key = p.payment_key AND pb2.bill_type = 'EDU_FEE' AND pb2.status = 'approved'), 0) ) ) < 0 THEN 0 ELSE ( (MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' AND pd.class_type = '1' THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END) + MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' AND pd.class_type = '2' THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END)) - ( ISNULL(pm.total_amount, 0) + ISNULL((SELECT SUM(pb2.amount) FROM erp_payment_bill pb2 WHERE pb2.payment_key = p.payment_key AND pb2.bill_type = 'EDU_FEE' AND pb2.status = 'approved'), 0) ) ) END AS unpaidEduAmount,
-- 교재비 미납금액 (MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'book_fee' AND pd.class_type = 1 THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END) + MAX(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'book_fee' AND pd.class_type = 2 THEN pd.amount ELSE 0 END)) - ISNULL(MAX(CASE WHEN pb.bill_type = 'BOOK_FEE' AND pb.status = 'approved' THEN pb.amount END), 0) AS unpaidBookAmount,
-- 교육비 billId (SELECT TOP 1 pb2.bill_id FROM erp_payment_bill pb2 WHERE pb2.payment_key = p.payment_key AND pb2.bill_type = 'EDU_FEE' ORDER BY pb2.created_at DESC, pb2.bill_id DESC) AS eduBillId,
-- 교재비 billId (SELECT TOP 1 pb3.bill_id FROM erp_payment_bill pb3 WHERE pb3.payment_key = p.payment_key AND pb3.bill_type = 'BOOK_FEE' ORDER BY pb3.created_at DESC, pb3.bill_id DESC) AS materialBillId,
-- 교육비 상태 ISNULL( (SELECT TOP 1 pm2.status FROM erp_payment_manual pm2 WHERE pm2.payment_key = p.payment_key AND pm2.student_id = p.student_id ORDER BY pm2.created_at DESC), (SELECT TOP 1 pb2.status FROM erp_payment_bill pb2 WHERE pb2.payment_key = p.payment_key AND pb2.bill_type = 'EDU_FEE' ORDER BY pb2.created_at DESC, pb2.bill_id DESC) ) AS eduStatus,
-- 교재비 상태 (SELECT TOP 1 pb3.status FROM erp_payment_bill pb3 WHERE pb3.payment_key = p.payment_key AND pb3.bill_type = 'BOOK_FEE' ORDER BY pb3.created_at DESC, pb3.bill_id DESC) AS materialStatus
FROM erp_payment p JOIN erp_payment_detail pd ON pd.payment_key = p.payment_key LEFT JOIN erp_payment_bill pb ON pb.payment_key = p.payment_key LEFT JOIN (SELECT student_id, SUM( ISNULL(card_amount, 0) + ISNULL(cash_amount, 0) + ISNULL(transfer_amount, 0) ) AS total_amount FROM erp_payment_manual pm WHERE pm.yy = #{year} AND pm.mm = #{month} GROUP BY student_id) pm ON pm.student_id = p.student_id WHERE p.yy = #{year} AND p.mm = #{month} GROUP BY p.student_id, p.payment_key, pm.total_amount)
SELECT s.student_id as studentId, s.student_name + ' ' + pa.parent_tel_last as studentName,
pay.paymentKey, pay.hanFee, pay.bookFee, pay.hanMaterialFee, pay.bookMaterialFee, pay.totalFee, pay.totalMaterialFee, pay.unpaidEduAmount, pay.unpaidBookAmount, pay.eduStatus, pay.materialStatus, pay.eduBillId, pay.materialBillId,
pa.parent_tel_first + pa.parent_tel_middle + pa.parent_tel_last AS parentPhone,
c.hanTeacher, c.bookTeacher, c.subject,
NULLIF( STUFF((SELECT ', ' + s2.student_name FROM erp_student s2 JOIN erp_parent pa2 ON s2.student_id = pa2.student_id WHERE pa2.parent_tel_middle = pa.parent_tel_middle AND pa2.parent_tel_last = pa.parent_tel_last AND s2.student_id != s.student_id AND s2.center_code = #{centerCode} AND s2.status_key NOT IN ('WITHDRAWN') FOR XML PATH (''), TYPE).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)'), 1, 2, ''), '' ) AS samePhoneStudents
FROM erp_student s

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, p.payment_key AS paymentKey, g.grade_name AS gradeName, hu.user_name AS hanTeacher, bu.user_name AS bookTeacher, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' THEN pd.amount END) AS amount FROM erp_payment p JOIN erp_payment_detail pd ON p.payment_key = pd.payment_key JOIN erp_student s ON p.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key LEFT JOIN erp_teacher_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id LEFT JOIN erp_user hu ON ta.assign_han_teacher = hu.user_code LEFT JOIN erp_user bu ON ta.assign_book_teacher = bu.user_code WHERE p.center_code = #{centerCode} AND p.yy = #{yy} AND p.mm = #{mm} AND p.status IN ('issued', 'pending') GROUP BY s.student_id, s.student_name, p.payment_key, g.grade_name, hu.user_name, bu.user_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN pd.item_type = 'EDU_FEE' THEN pd.amount END) > 0;

SELECT pb.id, pb.payment_key, pb.bill_id, pb.bill_type, pb.amount, pb.student_id, pb.center_code, pb.status, pb.created_at, pb.issued_date, pb.yy, pb.mm FROM erp_payment_bill pb JOIN (SELECT payment_key, bill_type FROM erp_payment_bill WHERE status = 'issued' GROUP BY payment_key, bill_type HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) d ON pb.payment_key = d.payment_key AND pb.bill_type = d.bill_type WHERE pb.status = 'issued' AND pb.created_at < (SELECT MAX(x.created_at) FROM erp_payment_bill x WHERE x.payment_key = pb.payment_key AND x.bill_type = pb.bill_type) ORDER BY pb.payment_key, pb.bill_type, pb.created_at;
